messages:
sofia: FYI noticed a weird double-alert loop during last night's rollout. SLO rule fired, then a downstream dedupe job reclassified it and the same rule fired again 2 mins later. Paging people twice.

kevin: Yikes. Which rule type? thresholds (absolute) or rate-based?

sofia: Absolute threshold on p95 latency with a 5m sliding window. Config: `window=5m, eval_freq=1m, notify_cooldown=10m`. The problem seems to be how we materialize windows for rollouts: old and new evalers run concurrently for ~3m during canary handoff.

nate: Ah right, during canary we spin up new alert-eval pods that read the same traffic but different routing rules. Fingerprint hasn't included `evaluator_instance` so dedupe sees distinct ids when state drifts.

priya: Ops impact: double pages count against oncall quota twice. We should avoid any change that increases pages-per-oncall during rollouts.

kevin: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) make notify dedupe tolerant to short-term evaluator churn (treat alerts with same rule+entity within 10m as same), or 2) pause notifications from the new evaluator until it catches up. Option 1 is safer.

sofia: I prefer 1. Implement a dedupe layer that normalizes fingerprint to canonical rule id + route_id + tenant_id, ignoring ephemeral evaluator id. Also respect `notify_cooldown`.

nate: Implementing dedupe change needs a migration note: some historical alerts will collapse in UI. Is that ok?

priya: That's acceptable if we document it in release notes. Also add telemetry to measure pages-per-oncall delta pre/post change.

kevin: Console UX tweak: make rollout mode visible on the rule details card (banner: "rule in canary rollout"), so SREs know duplicates could be rollout artifacts. Add a toggle to suppress notifications from canary evaluators for a specific rule.

sofia: I can add copy for the banner. Small ask: expose `evaler_id` in debug logs only, not in fingerprints.

nate: Will open API PR to strip evaluator ids from fingerprint: https://github.com/redwood/alerts-service/pull/1309. Also adding a new `dedupe_window_override` that can be set per-tenant.

priya: I'll update quota logic to ensure quota accounting dedupes by canonical alert id too, so we don't double-burn quota.

alert-bot: deploy started: api/alerts-service@dedupe-rollout-fix (canary)

alert-bot: deploy success: api/alerts-service@dedupe-rollout-fix -> canary :rocket:

kevin: For long-term we should rethink sliding-window semantics during incremental rollouts. Maybe only the oldest evaluator publishes state until new ones warm up. But that's more invasive. For now dedupe normalization + a console banner + quota fix should suffice.

sofia: Agreed. Let's monitor canary: telemetry panel "rollout-dedupe" (pages, uniq-alert-ids, evaluator-count). Nate, Priya, can you own the dashboard?

nate: I'll create it and add threshold alerts for >5% page increase.

priya: I'll adjust notify quota logic and run a sim on historical data.

sofia: Thanks. Schedule a 15min follow-up tomorrow 9:30am PT to decide global deploy.

(reacts: kevin :thumbsup:)
